delivery.title: Faandaare neldugol - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: "Pass" ɗoo firti tan ko serveer target oo artiri ngonka HTTP 2xx - ɗum tabitintaa system jaɓɓoowo oo tigi rigi mooftuɗo walla golloraaɗo ardorde ndee. Ƴeewto ɓanndu jaabawol ngol dow ko ngol haali tigi rigi; so tawii ko meere walla ko jaɓde tan, ndeen system ina waawi jaɓde ɗaɓɓaande ndee kono ina jaɓa walla ina yejjita payndaale ɗee e nder mum (inɗe/mbaydi fannuuji bonɗi wonande API mum , fannu ɗaɓɓaaɗo e bannge mum mo ndee payndaale naatnataa heen, ekn).

push.title: Webhooks yaltuɗi - Push Ardiiɓe & Kesɗitingol
push.intro: Ko waawi huutoreede haa timma e kala webhook : JSON , Formaasiyoŋ (x-www-formaasiyoŋ-urlencoded), walla mbaydi ɓanndu maa Custom tawa ina waɗi <fieldkey></fieldkey> nokkuuji (yeru <example></example> ) - ina gollira no hebbinde yamiroore cURL laawol gootol.
push.curlHelp: Paste yeru ɗaɓɓaande maɓɓe API docs walla Postman rokkata ma (e dokke goonga walla sample). URL , feere e hooreeji ina koppiree no woniri nii, kala jokkorgal e nder ɓanndu ina limtee les ngam waawde suɓaade hol fannu CRM kebbinirta ɗum e kala ardorde.

api.title: API maa - Naatgol laabi ɗiɗi ngam kala Siistem
api.intro: Kala system jogiiɗo kuutorgal API maa ina waawi sosde, janngude e kesɗitinde ardaade e aboneede e kewuuji ardaade. Neldu coktirgal ngal e nder hoore <hdr></hdr> , hono <bearer></bearer> , walla (so kuutorgal ngal waawaa waɗde hooreeji) hono <query></query> . Keeri: {{limit}} ɗaɓɓaaɗe e hojomaaji.
api.noPermission: Ko jogiiɗo yamiroore Njuɓɓudi Cuɓe tan waawi yiyde jokkorgal API .
api.shownOnce: Koppir ndee jokkorgal jooni, resndu ɗum nokku ɗo kisal woni ɗoo - ngam kisal ko laawol gootol tan hollirtee. So tawii ko majjuɗo, jibin keso.
api.regenerateConfirm: Sosde jokkorgal API kesal? Kuutorgal jooni ngal ina dartoo ɗoon e ɗoon e kala system kuutortooɗo ngal.
api.openApiHint: Naatde e mbaydi OpenAPI e nder Postman , Zapier , Make walla n8n ngam heɓde kala jokkorgal potngal huutoreede.
